content.text:
Built a complete, child-friendly nursery-rhyme game in `index.html`: listen to each bell pattern, then repeat it using the colored bells or **1–3** keys. Three songs get progressively longer; completing them helps Kitty leave the well and earns stars. Sound controls, replay, restart, and touch-friendly layouts are included.

I treated the title as inspiration for a gentle rhythm game and created the visuals and bell sounds directly in the page, with no external assets. Checked the game in desktop and mobile browsers and played through all three songs.
